pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.cambiar_preferencia: You can change your bank access preference here (App or Web).
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.url_app_auto: When you pay, TI will open {banco}'s {canal} based on your preference.

pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.error_adeudado: Amount owed cannot exceed the limit.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_ayuda: Best option: upload a clear statement photo. TI reads the image on the server (not the phone OCR). If that fails, paste the text as a fallback and review before saving.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_ayuda_con_foto: Upload a statement photo or paste the text. Review the data before saving.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_ayuda_solo_texto: Paste the statement text. TI will interpret it and fill the form.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_listo: Image OCR is ready on this machine. Prefer using the photo.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_instalar_lab: Image OCR is not on this PC. In Lab install Tesseract (winget install UB-Mannheim.TesseractOCR), close the terminal and restart Streamlit. Meanwhile you can paste text. On Streamlit Cloud photos work after redeploy.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_usar: Use these values in the form
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_aplicado: Fields filled. Review them and complete anything missing before saving.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_fallo: Could not read the image. Paste the text manually and analyze again.

pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.ocr_no_detectado: Not detected: {campos}. Fill it in manually in the form.
pantalla_registrar_tarjeta.limpiar_formulario_ayuda: Clears the analysis and every field so you can register another card from scratch.

wizard_tarjeta.paso1_texto: Upload your monthly statement (PDF and/or several photos). We use it to read your bank's rules: payment dates, credit limit, and late fees. That way we help you avoid giving free money to the bank in interest.
wizard_tarjeta.paso2_texto: Take a screenshot of your bank app's payment screen (where you see Current Balance and Statement Balance) or enter balances manually. This tells us where you stand today so you don't overpay or fly blind!
wizard_tarjeta.ocr_p1_ayuda: Photo(s) or PDF of your monthly statement. You can upload several captures at once. We detect limit, cut-off/payment dates, APR, and late fees.
wizard_tarjeta.ocr_p2_ayuda: Screenshot from the app showing Current Balance, Statement Balance, and minimum payment.
wizard_tarjeta.ocr_uploader_multi: Statement PDF and/or photos (you can select several)
wizard_tarjeta.ocr_multi_resumen: {n} file(s): {imgs} image(s), {pdfs} PDF(s). They will be merged into one record.
wizard_tarjeta.ocr_multi_ok: Multiple sources read and merged into one set of bank rules.
wizard_tarjeta.ocr_pdf_hint: If the PDF has no selectable text, screenshot the statement pages or paste the text below.
wizard_tarjeta.ocr_pdf_sin_texto: The PDF returned no text (it may be image-only). Upload JPG/PNG page screenshots or paste the text.
wizard_tarjeta.ocr_pdf_no_disponible: PDF reading is not available on this server. Upload images or paste the text.
wizard_tarjeta.ocr_p1_sin_reglas: We couldn't find bank rules. Check the photo or fill limit and dates manually.
wizard_tarjeta.ocr_p2_sin_saldos: We couldn't find balances. Check the screenshot or enter them manually.

pantalla_lista_tarjetas.grafico_fechas_ventana_cerrado_pendiente: You owe ${monto:,.2f} from the cycle that closed on {cierre}. You have until {pago} to pay ({dias} days). You are still within the grace period.

pantalla_lista_tarjetas.grafico_fechas_compras_leyenda: purchases in this period (see Usage tab for details)

pantalla_lista_tarjetas.grafico_fechas_mensaje_medio: Today is {hoy}. {dias} days left to pay on {pago}. Cut-off is {corte}. Start planning your payment.

ayuda_bancos.secciones_probables: Look for these sections (names may vary by app version):
ayuda_bancos.instruccion_captura: When you find the fees or charges screen: take a screenshot, upload it or paste the text, then tap Analyze.
ayuda_bancos.interpretacion_cargos: These are **extra charges** from your bank (late fees, penalties or period interest). Worth checking in your banking app.
ayuda_bancos.interpretacion_mora: I detected a **penalty rate** — usually applied when payment is late.
ayuda_bancos.interpretacion_tasas: These are the **reference rates** for your card from the screenshot.
ayuda_bancos.aplicar_opcional_nota: Only if you want Usage and Payments to use these rates. Extra charges are for reference.
ayuda_bancos.texto_manual: Or paste the text you see on screen
ayuda_bancos.texto_manual_placeholder: E.g. Annual rate 24.99% · Late fee up to $39
ayuda_bancos.ocr_no_disponible: OCR is not installed on this device. Paste the text manually and TI will parse it.
